brand.notes: Midea PK (Green Leaves Pvt Ltd, UAN 051-111-000-008) AC codes. Primary source = official Midea TSP error-code web app/API (tsp.midea.com) — machine-readable global table scoped to PK product families (Xtreme/Breezeless/Titan splits, MCA3 cassette, MCD ceiling, MFYA floor). Service-manual tables (R-series §10.1, MSG lamps, MDV outdoor LEDs) in separate series files. No static table on mideapakistan.com. Quarantines: US window/U-shape EL codes, portable/EACM P-codes, MAD soft-starter E001–E030, chiller/water MDV sections, onlytroubleshooting F0, Air Care P0, multi-brand arlington footers. PK has no window/portable line.
